text:
I tried teeth cleaning here for the first time and I'm very impressed! 1. The price is comparable to the private hospital I usually go to, and it's deductible from my social security insurance.
2. The dentist was gentle, it wasn't painful, and they did a great job. My mouth feels cleaner than when I went to the private hospital I used to go to.
3. All the staff were polite and courteous. I called to inquire before coming to the clinic, and they answered quickly and responded promptly to my LINE messages.
4. The place is spacious, has parking, and the equipment is clean and not intimidating.
5. The wait time was short and punctual. I really liked that.

I'll probably come back to this clinic for future treatments because it's closer to home than the hospital. I'm glad I chose to come here!
